newsitem.title: USA: Bio-Vascular files with FDA for software.
newsitem.headline: Bio-Vascular files with FDA for software.

text.p: Bio-Vascular Inc said its Vital Images unit filed a 510(k) application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration seeking clearance to market an advanced version of its medical visualization software for use in clinical diagnosis and surgical planning.
The new software has the three-dimensional visualization power of Vital Images' VoxelView 2.5, but is faster and easier to use, the company said.
Bio-Vascular president John Karcanes said, "The new product is designed to bring 3-D volume visualization into the clinical mainstream."
The company did not disclose specific product functions.

"At this time, we are not disclosing specific product functionality because it is our expectation that several elements of the new product can gain patent protection, and that application process is underway, " Karcanes said.
The company said, pending 510(k) clearance, it is planning to show the product at the December 1996 meeting of the Radiological Society of North America.
